info.name: RoomVox
info.summary: CalDAV-native room booking via any calendar app
info.description:
RoomVox makes it easy to book and manage rooms in your organization. Whether it's meeting rooms, lecture halls, studios, or shared spaces — users simply add a room to their calendar event and RoomVox takes care of the rest.
No separate booking portal needed. Rooms appear directly in the calendar app your team already uses.
**For users:** * Book rooms directly from your calendar — no extra tools * Instant confirmation or automatic approval requests * Email notifications with calendar attachments
**For admins:** * Full room management with groups, permissions, and availability rules * Auto-accept or manager approval workflow per room * Role-based access control (Viewer / Booker / Manager) * CSV import/export for easy migration from MS365/Exchange * Public REST API for displays, kiosks, and digital signage * Per-room email and SMTP configuration * Microsoft Exchange bidirectional sync
**Compatible calendar clients:** * Nextcloud Calendar * Apple Calendar (iOS/macOS) * Microsoft Outlook * Mozilla Thunderbird * eM Client
